description: Dependency updates (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, "Dependency updates"; modelled on the game repositories, 2026-11-10): one weekly PR for minor/patch/pin/digest updates, majors one by one, 3 days of stability for a new version, security fixes at any time. Every PR needs the owner's approval to merge (master is protected). Covers npm, the GitHub Actions, the Dockerfile and compose images in deploy/, the CI's scanner images and the LiveKit binary of the browser tests.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all non-major updates.

The LiveKit server image (deploy/calls) and the binary the browser tests run (scripts/calls-binary.mjs) move together, in their own PR: the binary's three SHA-256 values must be updated by hand in that PR, its CI fails until they are.

customManagers.description: The CI's scanner images, pinned by tag and digest in the workflows' env ("GITLEAKS_IMAGE: name:tag@sha256:…"), and the shellcheck image of the deployment checks.
The LiveKit binary of the browser tests (scripts/calls-binary.mjs, LIVEKIT_VERSION), from LiveKit's GitHub releases.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the weekly schedule and the stability wait.
